root_cause.text: The XFS attribute leaf block code fails to clear the base address of a freemap entry when its size is reduced to zero, leaving a zero-length freemap entry with a non-zero base that can subsequently overlap with other freemap entries and lead to data corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `fs/xfs/libxfs/xfs_attr_leaf.c` adds a check to set `ichdr->freemap[i].base = 0` when `ichdr->freemap[i].size == 0`, preventing zero-length freemaps with non-zero bases from causing overlapping freemaps and subsequent data loss.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reset zero-length freemap bases to zero in XFS attribute leaf blocks to prevent corruption from overlapping freemaps during removal.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check within the freemap loop to reset the base address of zero-sized freemap entries to zero and set the holes flag to 1.
intent_record.how: This prevents subsequent removal operations from misidentifying zero-length freemaps based on non-zero base addresses, avoiding the creation of overlapping freemaps.
